provider_report.reason: Native JSONL exposes no authoritative provider model/effort fields; request is pinned in argv and model self-report is not used.

write_denial.method: The installed native Codex sandbox -P :read-only ran Node fs.writeFileSync against controlled source/current/candidate sentinels. Reused the passed boundary check after MCP-only policy corrections; no unchanged probe rerun.
write_denial.model_patch_report: Model reported read-only/never rejection; ephemeral JSONL omits tool traces, so that self-report is not the authoritative denial evidence.

isolation.native_home: host-owned per-attempt scratch; native auth linked without reading/copying bytes
isolation.environment: host allowlist; no inherited provider key or hidden config
isolation.native_tools: shell, unified execution, plugins/apps/hooks, browser/computer and other external surfaces disabled; native code-mode dispatcher retained for MCP
isolation.mcp: only required generation_context and generation_submit; scoped preapproval of the user-authorized private host tools
isolation.housekeeping: ephemeral, isolated; recorded-session resume explicitly unsupported
